_description: Architecture sweep: hidden_dim x num_layers x seed. Run AFTER uniformity sweep completes so the training recipe is finalized. Edit the 'uniformity_reg_weight' and 'uniformity_t' fields based on the outcome of that sweep.
_notes: radial_reg_weight is NOT scaled with hidden_dim. Larger dims may experience slightly stronger effective boundary pressure because norm^2 has more contributing dimensions. This is a real confound flagged in the analysis report, not a bug to fix.
uniformity_reg_weight is set to the value chosen from the uniformity sweep outcome. Edit this field before running.
Tier 1 corpus only. Once the best config is found here, validate at tier 2 separately.
Expected wall-clock: ~4.5 hours training + ~15 min eval.
